thread:
jess_support: heads-up — customer reporting embeddings/rerank errors when sending batched payloads. says they get a 400 with "embedding dimension mismatch". pasted their curl and the error. asking ENG for repro steps and what to request next from customer.

sam_eng: ok can you paste the exact error text + the request_id from our logs? also did they send multiple items in "input" or a precomputed vector blob?

jess_support: customer error -> "400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024". our logs show request_id=req_01G7Xk2YVQz. they included this curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-ada-002","input":[[0.1,0.2,...1024 values...],[0.2,0.3,...1024 values...]]}'
```
they claim they were batching 2 vectors.

maya_ml: that payload looks like they are sending precomputed vectors (array of floats). our embedding models return 1536 dims for the new family; if they precomputed with an older model (1024) then server will reject. two failure modes: 1) customer is uploading vectors from another model 2) they intended to request generation but accidentally hit embeddings endpoint with text. Ask them for the exact shape we see in the logs — we already have one vector length 1024 logged.

sam_eng: ask customer to run this reproducible curl that includes explicit model and show the raw bytes (no jq) so we can see content-length and payload shape: 
```bash
# reproducible repro (ask customer to run and paste stdout)
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["foo","bar"]}'
```

jess_support: sent above to customer and asked for the exact request_id + the raw curl stdout including headers. also created a debug bundle (per usual) and shared link: https://internal.redwood/debug/bundle/DBG-20260315-77 (customer agreed to share logs). ops-bot just picked it up. :eyes:

repro-bot: debug bundle DBG-20260315-77 created for req_01G7Xk2YVQz, includes HTTP capture, server logs, and a snippet of embedding-metrics.

dave_infra: few quick checks while we wait: 1) confirm no intermediate proxy is reshaping payload (some customers POST through a gateway that serializes floats oddly) 2) verify client is not gzipping wrong (transfer-encoding vs content-encoding) 3) check they didn't mix up model families.

maya_ml: also helpful: run this tiny python validator and send output; it will assert each vector length and print shape summary. ask customer to run locally against the same JSON they posted:
```python
import json
obj = json.load(open('payload.json'))
inputs = obj.get('input')
if not isinstance(inputs, list):
    print('input not a list')
else:
    lens = [len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else None for x in inputs]
    print('counts:', len(inputs))
    print('lens sample:', lens[:5])
    assert all(isinstance(l, int) for l in lens), 'found non-list input'
```

sam_eng: if they can't run, ask them to paste the raw JSON (not a screenshot). if they claim the vectors are 1536 but our logs show 1024, we need the HTTP capture from the bundle and the curl --trace-ascii output (headers+body). also ask for the exact timestamp window: 2026-03-15 14:22:30 - 14:23:00 UTC so we can grep in infra logs.

jess_support: asked customer for the above and requested the curl -v output, python validator output, python -mjson.tool payload.json, and the debug bundle link. customer replied with trace but redacted keys — they included the response body showing the same error and our request_id. forwarding to ENG now.

dave_infra: once we have the bundle, look at the ingress code path for content-type handling. I can grep for req_01G7Xk2YVQz in the nginx+worker logs. if we see Content-Length smaller than expected, might indicate truncation.

maya_ml: one other angle — if they are sending an array-of-arrays but our server interprets as one concatenated vector because of a malformed JSON (missing comma), shape will not match. ask them to run `python -mjson.tool payload.json` and paste output.

jess_support: got it. I'll compile the checklist to send: raw curl -v, python validator output, python -mjson.tool payload.json, and the debug bundle link. will update when customer responds. :white_check_mark:
